title: Generalize Filter Kit Function with Glob Support
description: Generalize the filter kit with design to a general filter kit function. Accept designs, types, ports, files, etc. For all of them add glob support on names both for include and exclude.
summary: Generalized filterKitWithDesign to filterKit across all 5 languages (TypeScript, Go, Rust, Python, C#). Added GlobFilter (include/exclude string[] patterns) and KitFilter (designGuid, modelTags, plus GlobFilter per entity kind: designs, types, ports, files, tags, concepts, qualities, authors, folders). Implemented globMatch (supports * and ? wildcards, case-insensitive) and matchesGlobFilter helpers. Fixed vitest guard condition that prevented test discovery (removed stale cwd check). Fixed incorrect test assertion for W??l pattern. All tests pass: TS (125/125), Go (7/7), Rust (27/27), Python (6/6), C# filter tests (2/2).
